title: Find And Replace in String
summary: Given a 0-indexed string s and three parallel arrays, indices , sources , and targets , each of length k , perform k replacement operations simultaneously.
statement: Given a 0-indexed string s and three parallel arrays, indices , sources , and targets , each of length k , perform k replacement operations simultaneously. For each i -th operation, check if the substring sources[i] is found at the index indices[i] in the original string s . If the substring is found, replace it with targets[i] . Ensure that the replacements do not overlap. Return the resulting string after all replacements have been made.
constraints: Replacement checks use the original string and operations do not overlap.
Apply only sources that match at their given indices.
hints: Simultaneous means every match is tested against the unchanged source string.
Index operations and scan the source left to right.
At an operation index, append target and skip source length only if source matches; otherwise copy one character.
Nonoverlap makes the scan unambiguous and preserves every unreplaced character exactly once.
editorial: Nonoverlap makes the scan unambiguous and preserves every unreplaced character exactly once.
